set.heading: Software engineer at Alphero, in Wellington.
set.intro: I’m Hamish. I build software, and most of what’s on this site started with me wanting to find out how something worked, then building it on my own time. A lot of it comes back to the same two questions, who is allowed to reach a system, and what it does when part of it goes away.

largeCopy.__blockText: I work at Alphero as a software engineer. The projects here are things I’ve built outside that job. They look scattered, though most of them come back to the same thing, a system somebody else can reach, and what it does when a part of it fails.
